description: This Java abstract class defines protocol-specific validation logic for Connection objects within the Eclipse Ditto framework. It includes methods for validating URI schemes, sources, targets, payload mappings, and header mappings, as well as utility functions for placeholder validation and exception handling.

classes.name: AbstractProtocolValidator
classes.description: An abstract class providing protocol-specific validation logic for Connection objects, including validation of URI schemes, sources, targets, payload and header mappings, and placeholder processing within the Eclipse Ditto connectivity framework.

methods.name: type
methods.description: Abstract method to return the connection type this validator applies to.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Abstract method to validate a given connection, throwing exceptions if invalid.

methods.name: validateUriScheme
methods.description: Validates that the connection's URI scheme is within accepted and secure schemes, and throws exceptions otherwise.

methods.name: validateSourceConfigs
methods.description: Validates source configurations for the connection.

methods.name: validateSource
methods.description: Abstract method to validate individual source configuration.

methods.name: validateTargetConfigs
methods.description: Validates target configurations for the connection.

methods.name: validateTarget
methods.description: Abstract method to validate individual target configuration.

methods.name: validatePayloadMappings
methods.description: Validates payload mappings for sources and targets, ensuring correct placeholders and configuration.

methods.name: validateHeaderMapping
methods.description: Validates header mapping for placeholder correctness.

methods.name: sourceDescription
methods.description: Provides a supplier for a descriptive string about a source of a connection.

methods.name: targetDescription
methods.description: Provides a supplier for a descriptive string about a target of a connection.

methods.name: validateTemplate
methods.description: Validates a string template for correct placeholder syntax and usage.

methods.name: validateTemplateAndReplace
methods.description: Validates and replaces placeholders in a template with a dummy string, returning the processed string.
